errors.text_span: Das Diagramm zeigt den Anteil der Militärausgaben an den Bruttoinlandsprodukt (BIP) in der Europäischen Union
errors.evidence: The description specifies that the chart is about military spending in the European Union, but this information is not present in the image itself. The y-axis is only labeled "% des BIP".
The description states that the green line has small, square markers, but the line is a continuous, solid line with no markers.
In the year 1990, the value on the line is approximately 2.4%, not 2.2%. The line drops to 2.2% around the year 1992.

errors.text_span: fällt dann weiter auf etwa 1,5 % im Jahr 2015
errors.evidence: In 2015, the line reaches its minimum value, which is approximately 1.3%. The value of 1.5% is reached around 2008 and again around 2019, but it is not the value for 2015.

errors.text_span: Eine dünne, schwarze Linie verläuft horizontal bei 0 % und dient als Nulllinie.
errors.evidence: This sentence describes the x-axis, which is already implicitly defined. Stating it as a separate feature is redundant.
